text:
Didn't film this myself. Claude Code did.

It connected to my 11-year-old Sony TV over Wi-Fi, pressed the remote buttons, cast a video to my Chromecast, recorded the screen and cut the clip. All from the terminal, while I made coffee.

What you're seeing is Adam TV v2, the home screen I built to replace Sony's: greeting, weather, calendar, my apps, what's playing on the Chromecast, and a sleep timer that actually turns the TV off. Zero ads.

Most of these features came from your replies two days ago. The stutter is real too: this TV can only record itself at about 6 frames a second🤣.

What would you make your TV do? #BuildInPublic
what_they_built: Adam TV v2, a custom home screen for an 11-year-old Sony TV with weather, calendar, apps and a sleep timer, plus a demo clip that Claude Code filmed and cut itself.

text:
My phone is now a trackpad for my laptop. Claude wrote the code, and the cursor follows my finger.

Watch the screen on the right. I drag a finger on the phone, the cursor moves. I hit Right click and the context menu opens.

What I built:

an app on the phone and a small app on the laptop
they talk over Bluetooth
tap to click, hold to drag
left click, right click, center and pause buttons
a speed slider to tune the feel
I made it with Claude Code in a few hours.
Clicks and gestures were the hardest part to get right.
Right now there’s no scrolling and no two-finger gestures. Cursor and clicks only.

What should I add first, scrolling or two-finger gestures?
what_they_built: A phone app and a small laptop app, talking over Bluetooth, that turn the phone into a trackpad with tap, drag, left and right click, written with Claude Code in a few hours.

text:
In 2022 NASA crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid on purpose.

This week, ESA's Hera arrived to look at the damage. 🚀

I built an interactive 3D replay of the impact. You can rotate it, replay it, and watch the moon's orbit change.

🛠 Built with:
• Three.js + WebGL for the 3D scene
• Canvas 2D for the orbit model
• Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no framework
• Puppeteer + FFmpeg to render the video
• Claude Code as my pair programmer

@threejs @claudeai @ESA_Hera @NASA

#threejs #webgl #buildinpublic #indiedev
what_they_built: An interactive 3D replay of NASA’s DART impact, which you can rotate and replay to watch the moon’s orbit change, built with Claude Code as pair programmer.
